source: MAFF / ADB, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Bean crop — mung bean and black gram], official cultivation manual, 2005 (black gram sections)
text: This 2005 MAFF/ADB manual covers black gram (សណ្តែកប្រេង, Vigna mungo) alongside mung bean in a shared "សណ្តែកបាយ" (Bean crop) document — see the mung_bean product entry (Source B) for the shared botanical-classification, climate, and land-preparation content that applies to both crops jointly. Black gram-specific content within the shared chapters covers this species' distinct nutrition-table values and its own basal/top-dress fertilizer rate recommendations, which the manual notes differ somewhat from mung bean's.
